name: Cable Woodchopper High Speed
description: A high-velocity cable woodchopper aimed at training rotational power for sport. The explosive rotation from high to low develops the same energy transfer pattern used in throwing, swinging, and striking sports. The speed demands coordination and reactive core stability.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Cable Woodchopper High Speed in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Cable Woodchopper High Speed.
steps: Step 1: Set cable high on pulley. Stand sideways with arms extended to cable.
Step 2: Rotate explosively, pulling cable diagonally downward across body.
Step 3: Finish at low opposite position, following through fully.
Step 4: Return slowly and repeat, using power for each chopping rep.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
common_mistakes: Using arms instead of rotating from hips
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Power comes from hip rotation, not arms
Pivot trailing foot for full rotation
